title: Kernel engineering is a single-person bottleneck
cause_event_effect: Only one kernel engineer in S1/S2 → M0–M1 kernel load 96.6 pd runs serially → walking skeleton and library lock-in arrive late (S14 in S2) and every geometry-dependent milestone slips
trigger_early_warning: Kernel tasks started late vs ref_sprint_S2 for 2 sprints; M1 burn-up below P50
mitigation_preventive: Staff a second geometry engineer for M0–M2 (S3); move TT-V to QA (done); keep kernel tasks small (≤ 5 pd split rule)
contingency: Apply MVP-Should cut line for kernel items (KOP-02, KOP-12, KOP-03); re-run schedule

title: Backend engineering bottleneck in M2 and M5
cause_event_effect: One backend FTE carries 191 pd incl. the M2 governance block (65.9 pd) and M5 approval/export → troughs in other pools and late M5
trigger_early_warning: Backend queue > 2 sprints of ready tasks
mitigation_preventive: Second backend engineer during M2 and M5 (S3); full-stack engineer takes TT-A/TT-J tasks
contingency: Defer RPT/DES-07/CFG-03 (cut line)

title: Own self-intersection detector too slow on real scans
cause_event_effect: Ghost layers in Artec exports create many BVH candidate pairs → integrity job and post-op guard exceed time budgets → unusable editing latency
trigger_early_warning: X-02 synthetic ghost-layer timings superlinear; BM-02 face counts high
mitigation_preventive: Exact-predicate filter + BVH (IDR-10); incremental guard mode; time budget with SELF_INTERSECTION_TIMEOUT; numba inner loops
contingency: Commercial CGAL licence decision (TD-05 fallback) or C++ extension

title: numba results not bit-identical across hosts or JIT warm-up too long
cause_event_effect: Determinism requirement VER-07 fails or worker start is slow → approval reproducibility at risk
trigger_early_warning: X-06 shows differing hashes or warm-up > acceptable
mitigation_preventive: fastmath/parallel off, pinned wheels, single image digest (TD-19); X-06 in S02
contingency: C++/nanobind extension for the same loops (IDR-10 fallback)

title: Cross-host determinism fails (BM-03)
cause_event_effect: Different CPU families produce different float results → approved design cannot be reproduced on a new host
mitigation_preventive: Same image digest everywhere; kernel images retained (IDR-19); single architecture (IDR-09)
contingency: Pin host CPU family or documented tolerance (decision OD-06)

title: Defect in the exact-predicate port
cause_event_effect: An error in the adaptive arithmetic silently returns wrong signs → wrong self-intersection, contour simplicity or point-in-polygon results
trigger_early_warning: Any disagreement with the rational oracle on T13
mitigation_preventive: 100 % agreement with Python fractions on ≥ 10^5 adversarial cases; two-reviewer rule
contingency: Fall back to exact rational slow path for affected calls

title: Closure option A fails on real open scans
cause_event_effect: Holes above the base plane or non-simple base contours are frequent → closure rejected often → technicians blocked at design
trigger_early_warning: X-03 rejection rate on BM-02 scans
mitigation_preventive: Recorded cleanup and hole filling before closure; clear OP_REJECTED reasons in UI
contingency: Re-open IDR-01/IDR-30; add a recorded cleanup op; consider manifold3d Boolean for base block (reserve)

title: Supabase Storage cannot deny overwrite/delete to the app credential
cause_event_effect: Immutability of originals and artifacts (INV-02, FR-011) cannot be enforced by policy
mitigation_preventive: IF-04 no-overwrite logic + content addressing; delete only via purge credential (IDR-07)
contingency: Move blobs to S3-compatible storage with object lock

title: Storage objects not covered by platform backups
cause_event_effect: Supabase DB backups exclude Storage → scans/exports/prescriptions lost after an incident
mitigation_preventive: Separate daily encrypted restic backup to another provider; restore drill re-verifies SHAs (FN-OPS-05, FN-BLB-03)
contingency: Manual export of buckets until backup job is fixed; stop real-data intake

title: VER-22 privacy inspection delayed
cause_event_effect: Privacy specialist unavailable or findings open → real-patient-data gate stays closed → no real-scan experiments, no pilot
trigger_early_warning: Inspection not scheduled by M2 mid-point
mitigation_preventive: Book the specialist at M0; prepare evidence pack via FN-OPS-10; dry run on staging
contingency: Continue on synthetic data; shift M3 real-scan experiments and M7

title: Clinic configuration values and thresholds late
cause_event_effect: Landmark set, definitions, gate thresholds, export frame, checklist (DEC-029) and pilot thresholds (DEC-030) not provided → pilot cannot start
trigger_early_warning: No clinic session booked by M5
mitigation_preventive: Build with NOT_SET + test configurations; configuration editor ready in M2; request values with a checklist at M3
contingency: Hold RC; continue with v1.1 preparation

title: Real scans exceed size assumptions or use unexpected formats
cause_event_effect: Face counts, file sizes or Artec export variants differ from synthetic assumptions → parse/integrity/viewer budgets break
mitigation_preventive: Face caps and upload caps from evidence (XC-PLT-03); decimate op (Should) ready; sandbox limits
contingency: Promote FN-KOP-03 to Core; tune LOD budget

title: Viewer too slow on clinic PCs
cause_event_effect: Unknown browsers/hardware (NFR-01/02) → poor frame rate on full-resolution meshes
mitigation_preventive: Display LOD (IDR-12), Web Worker BVH, early clinic IT inventory (XC-PLT-02)
contingency: Lower LOD budget; recommend hardware; vtk.js fallback

title: Systematic under-estimation
cause_event_effect: Novel geometry and medical-grade traceability inflate effort beyond the most-likely plan
mitigation_preventive: Commit at P80 (≈1
contingency: 010 pd); stabilisation reserve 10 % per milestone; re-estimate at each milestone exit

title: Scope creep into shell generation, AI or follow-up features
cause_event_effect: Requests to add post-MVP items during development dilute capacity
trigger_early_warning: New items proposed without RTM change; see DR-31 for Rodin4D parity requests
mitigation_preventive: MVP_SCOPE exclusion criteria; change control via RTM + WBS regeneration
contingency: Defer to v1.1 backlog

title: Decision record not ratified
cause_event_effect: IDR set remains unsigned → 16 previously blocked tasks cannot formally start; rework if a decision changes late
mitigation_preventive: Ratify in sprint 1; IDRs designed to be reversible where possible (Rev. column)
contingency: Start with tasks not depending on XC-FND-01; escalate

title: Clinical-claim wording slips into UI, reports or logs
cause_event_effect: Words implying diagnosis, severity or prescription appear → misuse risk and regulatory exposure (STK-05, FR-045)
mitigation_preventive: Merge-blocking wording lint (FN-OPS-01); i18n-only strings; PO review of ru strings
contingency: Hotfix release; incident note

title: Personal data leaks into logs, repository or AI prompts
cause_event_effect: Prescription identifiers, scans or credentials exposed in logs, fixtures, issues or Claude Code sessions
trigger_early_warning: Secret/PII scan hits; log-scrubbing test failures
mitigation_preventive: Log scrubbing test; synthetic fixtures only; secret scanning; DEVELOPMENT_STANDARDS §12
contingency: Incident procedure (SEC-14); rotate credentials; purge

title: GPL/AGPL code reaches a shipped image
cause_event_effect: Oracle tools or a transitive dependency with copyleft licence enter production images
mitigation_preventive: Allow-list gate (FN-OPS-02); oracle container separate and never pushed; legal review (XC-PLT-10)
contingency: Replace dependency; rebuild images

title: Library upgrade silently changes geometry
cause_event_effect: numpy/scipy/numba or LOD library update alters numeric results → golden hashes change, approvals irreproducible
mitigation_preventive: Exact pins; determinism-review label; full regression before merge; kernel image retention
contingency: Revert upgrade; op_version bump with justification

title: Audit chain head lock limits throughput or deadlocks
cause_event_effect: Serialised appends under concurrent requests/jobs cause latency or lock contention
trigger_early_warning: BM-05 audit append p95; lock wait alerts
mitigation_preventive: Short transactions; single-row head lock; ≤ 5 users (A-16); BM-05 measurement
contingency: Per-case chains (ALG-58 alternative)

title: Approval-binding or export-gate defect
cause_event_effect: Export proceeds for geometry that differs from the approved version, or without prescription binding
mitigation_preventive: Two-reviewer rule; tamper test per binding (5 bindings); hash re-check at export (FR-101); re-import check
contingency: Stop exports; incident; fix + regression

title: No access to Rodin4D Neo or production for physical checks
cause_event_effect: VER-06 Neo comparison, VER-04 and VER-16 cannot be executed
mitigation_preventive: Ask clinic at M3; prepare comparison protocol and file samples early
contingency: Pilot with documented open verification item and restricted use

title: Limited availability of the engineering lead / decision maker
cause_event_effect: Decisions, reviews and sign-offs (IDR, ADR, lock-in, two-reviewer paths) queue up behind one person with other duties
mitigation_preventive: Delegate review ownership via CODEOWNERS; batch decisions at sprint boundaries; written decision records
contingency: Named deputy for reviews; product owner signs scope decisions

title: AI-generated code introduces subtle defects
cause_event_effect: Plausible but wrong geometry or security code passes superficial review
trigger_early_warning: Defects found by oracles/tamper tests in AI-authored PRs
mitigation_preventive: Same CI gates; independent TT-V; two-reviewer paths; no golden-hash updates without justification (§12)
contingency: Revert; add regression test

title: Hole filling (Should) overruns
cause_event_effect: Liepa triangulation + refinement + fairing is the largest Should item (14 pd ML) and data-dependent
mitigation_preventive: Fairing behind a flag; n_max from BM-02; rank 12 on cut line
contingency: Cut to v1.1; clinics fill holes in Artec Studio

title: API contract churn breaks the UI
cause_event_effect: Frequent breaking changes to /api/v1 cause rework in the frontend
mitigation_preventive: Error catalogue frozen at M0 (IDR-05); additive-only rule; generated client
contingency: ADR + /v2 path for unavoidable breaks

title: Measurement definitions differ from the clinic's manual method
cause_event_effect: Contour, centre or diagonal conventions differ → VER-23 shows bias → pilot success criterion missed
trigger_early_warning: Phantom comparison with clinic method at M3; early VER-23 dry run
mitigation_preventive: Definition fields configurable (IDR-03); show definition with every value; compare with manual method on phantoms before pilot
contingency: Adjust definition (no code change); document bias

title: Russian terminology unclear to technicians
cause_event_effect: UI terms do not match clinic vocabulary → errors and slower design (VER-10)
mitigation_preventive: Glossary from DOMAIN_GLOSSARY; review of ru strings by clinic technician in M3/M5 demos
contingency: String update release

title: Hosting region conflicts with data-residency rules
cause_event_effect: Supabase/host region outside Kazakhstan may conflict with LQ-03 if confirmed → relocation
mitigation_preventive: Region recorded in deployment record; architecture portable (compose + Postgres + S3 API)
contingency: Migrate to a compliant region/provider; restore from backups

title: Feature-parity pressure versus Rodin4D
cause_event_effect: Technicians compare Jude with Rodin4D tool by tool (CN-2026-11-17 showed ~20 tools) → requests for TLSO/limb tools (Bend, Extrusion, Toe Box) or more zone variants inflate scope and delay the pilot
trigger_early_warning: New tool requests not traceable to helmet work
mitigation_preventive: Observe a helmet session first (XC-PLT-13); only helmet-relevant tools enter the RTM; MVP_SCOPE exclusion criteria; cut line
contingency: Move requests to v1.1 backlog

title: Free-form zone contours fail on real surfaces
cause_event_effect: Contour drawn on the LOD crosses thin regions, folds, the closure base or itself → wrong region membership or rejected ops; profile editor allows shapes that create folds
trigger_early_warning: Rejection rate of zone ops in X-04/usability sessions; GT failures on T8 contours
mitigation_preventive: Anchors snapped server-side on full mesh; simple-polygon check with exact predicates; region resolved on full resolution; guard after every op; monotone profile interpolation
contingency: Fall back to circle/ellipse presets; restrict custom profiles to presets

title: Live metrics latency makes the workspace feel slow
cause_event_effect: Live metrics (FN-DES-08) and overlay (FN-UIX-07) add section, volume and distance computations to every regeneration → edit-to-preview latency grows beyond technicians' tolerance
mitigation_preventive: Compute metrics in the regeneration job from cached ops; only the edited op and later ops recompute (ALG-53); deviation on display LOD for the overlay
contingency: Compute metrics on demand (button) instead of every edit
